description: Every built-in string Suggested edits shows, InlineDiff's included; `labels` overrides any of them.

applied.type: (count: number, edits: string, total: string) => string
applied.description: The receipt, and its announcement: «طُبّق تعديلان من ٣».

change.description: Names a change by what it does: «حذف «…» وإضافة «…»».

plainText.description: Shown when the selection spans formatting.

region.description: Names the text region the person selects in.

reviewing.description: Announced when the card opens; `edits` is the count with its noun.

rewriting.description: The note below the selection while the assistant rewrites it, and its announcement.

shortcut.description: Describes each button with its key: «اختصار لوحة المفاتيح: Y».

title.description: The card's heading, before the suggestion's own title.
